## Critique
- claim-1: The argument correctly proves the stated basis and relation lattice for \(0\le k\le b=\min(i,j)\), conditional on the accepted interval/Schur/Pieri presentation. The Pieri identity has exactly the two asserted in-box terms, and the \(t=1\) rows generate the lattice. It should explicitly write
  \[
  (A_+M)_{d+k}=\sum_{t=1}^{k}h_tM_{d+k-t},
  \]
  using \(A_+=(h_1,h_2,\ldots)\), to justify that these are all multiplication relations. More importantly, the unqualified “each degree \(d+k\)” target is not established beyond \(k=b\). Thus the target is established only under the bounded interpretation \(0\le k\le b\), not literally in all degrees.

## Repair certificates
- [proof-attempt] If all degrees are intended, classify the admissible indices \(x\) for every \(0\le k\le i+j+1\), include boundary one-term Pieri rows when \(P_{x,k-x}\) is absent, and prove the resulting complete relation-lattice equality.

## Required revisions
- State the exact range of \(k\).
- Identify the relation subgroup explicitly as \((A_+M)_{d+k}\) and prove its reduction to the \(h_t\)-rows.
- Explicitly conclude whether only the bounded target or the literal all-degree target is claimed.
